about_the_game:
This DLC includes a new character
Yasel

A highly popular professional Coser from South Korea, she has garnered widespread attention for her exceptional character accuracy and captivating stage presence. Invited to a major domestic comic convention, she made a stunning appearance on the first day as a fox spirit, with an agile and enchanting look and a mesmerizing aura that quickly made her the center of attention, drawing countless photographers.

However, her unprecedented popularity sparked discontent among some peers. Due to the large number of fans following and photographing her, many other Cosers on site were overlooked. Shortly after, Yasel faced multiple anonymous reports, citing reasons such as "revealing clothing" and "alleged suggestive gestures." As a result, she was forced to change into casual attire on the second day and assist at a booth as staff—only able to interact with fans in a limited capacity.

Despite maintaining an extremely low profile, she was reported again due to visa-related issues, ultimately leading to her early withdrawal from the event and a quiet departure.
